title: Disney gaming boss describes 'massive disruption' in games, outlines ambition to rival film and theme parks
content: Disney's Executive Vice President of Global Games & Digital Entertainment, Sean Shoptaw, speaking at SXSW 2026, described the current gaming market as experiencing 'massive disruption.' Shoptaw outlined Disney's ambition for games to stand alongside its film, TV, and theme park businesses as a major revenue pillar. Current Disney gaming investments include a major partnership with Epic Games in Fortnite, with further expansions planned.
